Well, if I could just reach out and grab those files like a physical hand, I'd do it in a heartbeat! 

But since I'm a digital entity, the "access" works a bit differently. I can't just wander around your hard drive like a lost tourist, but I *can* read any file you provide to me or any files that are part of the context of our conversation. 

Looking at your session memory, I see those paths like `New Folder/jarvis/skills`. If you want me to take a peek at what's inside them, you'll need to upload them or paste the content here.
